## One Olympic timeline, three lenses

The broadest view follows every Summer Olympic athlete-event entry. The gold trace then zooms in: first on all indoor and beach **Volleyball** entries, then on beach volleyball alone, identified from the **event** field. Each panel has its own vertical scale so the specialist event remains visible.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: "Athlete-event entries at Summer Olympic Games. Panels use separate vertical scales."

ggplot(
  participation_by_year,
  aes(x = year, y = records, color = series, group = series)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.05) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2) +
  facet_wrap(~series, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "All Summer sport entries" = "#315d70",
      "Volleyball sport entries" = "#0e8292",
      "Beach volleyball event entries" = "#c99837"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Athlete-event records",
    color = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Source: olympicAthletes::olympic_athletes.",
      scales::comma(summer_records_used),
      "Summer Games records aggregated; the dataset contains",
      scales::comma(source_records),
      "records overall."
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#10384a"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "#355260"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#637780", hjust = 0)
  )
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What counts as a record?

One row represents one athlete at one Games edition in one event—not one unique person or one team. The source has **`r scales::comma(source_records)`** rows; the chart aggregates the **`r scales::comma(summer_records_used)`** Summer Games rows. Beach volleyball is filtered from `event` within the Volleyball sport, rather than treating all Volleyball entries as beach volleyball.
:::

**Sources:** [olympicAthletes package and data documentation](https://moderndive.github.io/olympicAthletes/). See [methodology and results sources](road-to-gold.qmd#methodology) for team-medal counting and the recent podium supplement.
